name: Chaotic Axe
description: A wild, top-heavy thing that fights as much as it is wielded.

name: Bestial Hide
description: The hide of something large and unlucky, cured to a stubborn toughness.

name: Pulse Stone
description: A cave-crystal that beats, slow and steady, like a sleeping heart.

name: Bat Wing Boots
description: Stretched membrane that falls on stone without a whisper.

name: Ruinous Axe
description: Bigger, meaner, and somehow better balanced — chaos with the faintest thread of discipline.

name: Dire Bestial Hide
description: From a beast the deep-cavern folk name only in low voices.

name: Resonant Gem
description: A gem that rings on its own in the dark, answering a song no one else hears.

name: Cavern Sprints
description: Worn smooth on tunnel floors no map has ever charted.

name: Cataclysm Axe
description: Chaos given an edge — and, at last, a little rhythm. Every fifth swing still finds only air.

name: Deepscale Hide
description: Layered scale over thick hide — nothing fancy, just the most of everything that stops a blow.

name: Echo Geode
description: It pulses on its own clock, and hums a low, steady mending between the beats.

name: Echostep Treads
description: They give back no sound at all — not even the echo the deep stone expects.

name: Tempered Core
description: Balanced for any hand. It asks no commitment, and rewards none in particular.

name: Duelist Core
description: Each direct hit on the same target sharpens your focus. Change targets, and the edge must be honed again.

name: Flash Rapier
description: Forged thin as a reed by duelists who prized speed above all.

name: Shaded Bindings
description: Woven in the dappled dark beneath the canopy, where shadow clings to cloth.

name: Heartroot Amulet
description: Heartroot drawn from the oldest tree in the grove, still faintly warm.

name: Sprinter Wraps
description: Strips of supple hide that move when you move, and never before.

name: Gale Needle
description: A fencing blade machined to an impossible point, humming faintly when drawn.

name: Thorn Needle
description: The same blade, barbed — it bites and lets the wound do the rest.

name: Phantom Bindings
description: They say the weaver vanished the day it was finished. The cloth remembers the trick.

name: Ancient Heartroot Amulet
description: A relic of a grove that burned an age ago, its life somehow undimmed.

name: Windstep Wraps
description: Light enough that the wind mistakes the wearer for one of its own.

name: Stinger Rapier
description: A thin blade kept slick with something the jungle distilled and never named.

name: Verdant Weave
description: A living mesh of leaf and creeper, too quick and too giving to be struck square.

name: Canopy Heart
description: A knot of ancient vine that wakes, slowly, to the rhythm of a long fight.

name: Vine Wraps
description: Springy growth lashed to the feet, always eager to be running.

name: Venomthorn Rapier
description: Thin and quick, and slick with a thorn-sap that bites a little more with every touch.

name: Wildgrowth Weave
description: A living mesh of leaf and vine, too quick and too giving to ever quite be struck square.

name: Worldvine Heart
description: It wakes slowly to a long fight, and by the end is pouring life back faster than it leaves.

name: Canopy Striders
description: They crash through the green loud enough to turn every hungry thing your way.

name: Deathfang Rapier
description: Quick past seeing, and slick with something the deep jungle spent a long time perfecting.

name: Primal Canopy
description: The faster you move through the green, the less of you there is to strike.

name: Ancient Canopy
description: Older than the trees around it, and by a long fight's end it is pouring life back faster than any blade can take it.

name: Overgrowth Pulse
description: It grows past the wound and keeps growing, hardening the surplus into a living shell.

name: Warpath Treads
description: They tear through the green loud enough to wake the whole canopy — and bring all of it to you at once.

name: Survivalist Core
description: Wound-knit heartwood. It does not stop the blow — it shortens the time you spend regretting it.

name: Bruiser Core
description: Kill, and the jungle opens. Stop, and it closes. The core only knows how to do the first one.

name: Accelerant Core
description: The canopy keeps a fast rhythm. Match it, and you will find you are swinging before you decide to.

name: Verdant Flywheel
description: Its living spokes turn faster with every gift the mechanic gives back.

name: Heavy Hammer
description: Two-handed, brutal, and honest. It asks only that you find the time to swing it.

name: Fallen Knight Plate
description: Stripped from a knight who fell at the high pass and was never named.

name: Granite Barrier
description: A palm of carved granite, cold and patient as the peak it came from.

name: Iron Treads
description: Heavy soles that bite into scree and loose rock alike.

name: Quake Hammer
description: When it lands, the ground remembers it longer than the foe does.

name: Iron Crusader Plate
description: Masterwork plate of the old crusades, dented in a hundred places, breached in none.

name: Iron Bulwark
description: A ward-stone the mountainfolk pass down, hand to weathered hand.

name: Mountain Stride
description: Forged for those who treat a sheer slope as a road.

name: Avalanche Maul
description: It does not so much strike as arrive, the way a slope arrives on a village.

name: Summit Aegis
description: Forged for those who plan to be hit by something the size of a house and walk on.

name: Bastion Heart
description: A core of mountain-heart stone that raises a wall of itself, over and over.

name: Peak Stride
description: Not even the mountain can keep you from your prey.

name: Earthsunder Maul
description: It does not strike the earth so much as remind it of an old grievance.

name: Warmaul
description: Lighter in the haft, quicker to the shoulder — it rewards the soldier who already knows when to swing.

name: Titan's Keep
description: The blow that should have ended you instead rings the walls — and the walls answer by standing back up.

name: Stormwall Plate
description: Built to take the storm head-on and turn what it absorbs back into a second wind.

name: Fortress Heart
description: A keep in miniature: it throws up a wall, lets it fall, and throws up another, tireless as siegework.

name: Shieldmend Ward
description: When the ward shatters, it gives back a little of the blow it ate.

name: Vanguard Stride
description: While a foe stands at distance, they close the gap as if the mountain itself leaned them forward.

name: Juggernaut Core
description: The mountain does not dodge. It simply outlasts whatever is thrown at it, and so will you.

name: Arcanist Core
description: Thin air, long thoughts. The gap between what you can do and how often shrinks.

name: Colossus Heart
description: A mountain heartbeat: slow enough to feel inevitable, heavy enough to end the argument.

name: Equilibrium Shard
description: A clean answer with no hidden edge: a little more rhythm, a little more force.

name: Iron Broadsword
description: Mass-forged for the ranks, dependable as sunrise. Ten thousand like it have won quiet wars.

name: Survivor's Robe
description: Field plate patched and repatched by those who lived to patch it.

name: Plains Stone
description: A sun-warmed stone from the heart of the grasslands, humming with quiet vigor.

name: Fleet Boots
description: Open sandals built for crossing flat ground at a dead run.

name: Knight's Steelsword
description: A knight sidearm kept keen by habit and pride — plain, proven, never flashy.

name: Enduring Robe
description: Plate that has outlasted the wars it was made for, and the smith who made it.

name: Stalwart Heart
description: A greater plains-stone, its warmth swelling with every foe laid low.

name: Gale Boots
description: Wind-cured leather that seems to lean into every stride.

name: Poison Dagger
description: A short blade kept slick with mire-venom that refuses to dry.

name: Arcane Wrappings
description: Marsh-cloth steeped in old wardings against rot and fume.

name: Murk Eye
description: A preserved golem eye, still weeping faint green light.

name: Marsh Treads
description: Broad soles that ride the surface of soft, sucking ground.

name: Venom Knife
description: The venom runs deeper now; what it touches keeps rotting.

name: Bog Wrappings
description: Cloth drawn from the deepest mire, where even the water has forgotten the sun.

name: Bog Eye
description: A bog-touched eye that drinks deep and gives quietly back.

name: Wetland Wraps
description: Enchanted bindings that find footing where there should be none.

name: Plague Fang
description: The rot it carries does more work than the edge ever could.

name: Plaguebound Shroud
description: It turns the blows you take into a slow ache it then refuses to feel.

name: Sorrow Eye
description: It weeps for every wound, and gives the tears back as strength.

name: Mire Striders
description: Nothing the bog grips holds them; they walk free of any mire that tries to keep them.

name: Permafrost Maul
description: Each blow leaves a deep frost-crack; armor that takes enough of them simply gives.

name: Rimebrand
description: The first true frost-brand — slow and heavy, planting a cold in the wound that goes on biting after the blade is gone.

name: Glacial Bulwark
description: Stand still and the ice creeps over the plate, until you are part of the glacier itself.

name: Frostward Charm
description: A rime-cold ward that throws up a sheet of ice, and drinks the blows that get through.

name: Glacier Striders
description: They gather momentum across the ice and are loath to give it back.

name: Glacial Tyrant Maul
description: Every blow leaves a deeper frost-crack; the eighth simply ends the argument about whether armor holds.

name: Glacial Rimebrand
description: It does not cut so much as plant a cold that goes on spreading after the blade is gone.

name: Permafrost Sovereign
description: Hold your ground and the glacier claims you for its own — and nothing moves a glacier.

name: Glacial Ward
description: A sheet of ice thrown up against the blow, and a slow cold that drinks whatever slips past it.

name: Deepfreeze Ward
description: The longer the cold has to settle in, the more of the blow it swallows whole.

name: Avalanche Striders
description: Slow to start and impossible to stop — by the far end of the ice you are a thing that simply happens to whatever is in the way.

name: Scout Core
description: Open ground and a long horizon. Nothing here helps you win a stand — only avoid one.

name: Glacial Bell
description: It rings only when the moment is ready, and every boon carries the note.

name: Sunsteel Falchion
description: Sun-forged and ward-etched: the opening blow breaks, and for a few breaths after it the light does not let go.

name: Duneplate of the Last Stand
description: Plate of the standfast dead, who are said to have refused to fall even once.

name: Mirage Talisman
description: A shard of cooled glass that shows you water which is not there, and mends what is.

name: Sand Sprint
description: Wide and light, made to outpace a storm across open dune.

name: Solar Falchion
description: It spends its fury on the opening blow, then burns on a while in the wound it made.

name: Eternal Duneplate
description: Worn by the standfast dead, who shed curses like sand and refused, once, to die.

name: Oasis Heart
description: A patient spring that helps you find the strength to purge curses and break your bonds again sooner.

name: Mirage Striders
description: By the time the storm reaches where you stood, you are already a rumor on the next dune.

name: Zenith Falchion
description: At the sun's height the opening cut lets in the whole day, and it takes its time going out.

name: Deathless Duneplate
description: The standfast dead refused to fall — and the wounds closed as the refusal held.

name: Last Oasis
description: The last spring never runs dry; each purge and broken bond brings the next within reach.

name: Simoom Striders
description: Named for the desert wind that arrives only as the dust it already left behind.

name: Force Core
description: It gives you the strike you wanted and takes the margin you were counting on.

name: Sniper Core
description: Focuses the eye to a needlepoint, and leaves the body that much more exposed.

name: Withering Lens
description: It takes its time finding the flaw, then makes the flaw impossible to ignore.

name: Cinderlash
description: A whip of braided ember that strikes faster the longer it burns.

name: Emberforge Plate
description: Plate quenched in a lava flow; it thickens against a steady fire and cracks only to a true blow.

name: Magmaheart Stone
description: A still-molten heart that mends you mid-fight, and flares with every kill.

name: Magma Walkers
description: Quick as a thrown spark — until a solid blow knocks the wind from them.

name: Eruption Lash
description: A braided whip of ember that strikes faster the longer it is allowed to burn.

name: Cinderbrand
description: It leaves a fire under the skin that does the rest of the work while you move on.

name: Pyroclasm Mantle
description: It thickens against a steady fire until, at its hardest, it shrugs off even a true blow — once.

name: Lava-Tempered Hide
description: Quenched in a living flow, it banks the overflow of your own healing into a crust of fresh stone.

name: Inferno Heart
description: A heart that never fully cools — it mends you mid-swing and flares brighter with every fallen foe.

name: Pyroclast Treads
description: Swift as a thrown ember — until a solid blow stalls them, and the heat must build again.

name: Catalyst Core
description: Amplifies on-hit damage you already have; it grants none by itself. Armour is no comfort against something already inside it.

name: Hastebound Dial
description: The dial runs ahead of every rhythm, trading weight for relentless motion.

name: Plague Axe
description: Every third stroke lands flat and harmless — and leaves the rot to make the next one count double.

name: Plaguebound Mantle
description: The denser the swarm, the thicker the crust of clinging filth — and the harder you are to bite.

name: Grave Ward
description: It lets the debt of a hundred small wounds come due all at once — and then forgives it, once.

name: Necrotic Pulse
description: A slow, certain throb of returning life, timed like a tired heart that refuses to stop.

name: Grave-Tide Pulse
description: A tide that never fully goes out — it gives back in a steady seep between the larger swells.

name: Gravewalker Boots
description: Each fallen foe lends a little of its lingering haste — and the more that fall, the harder it becomes to hold you down.

name: Controller Core
description: The swamp never kills quickly. It simply makes sure nothing leaves the way it came in.

name: Haunted Prism
description: The prism weakens the pulse itself so every blessing and affliction can linger with greater force.

name: Abyssal Axe
description: Patient through the long fight, merciless at the end of it: when the abyss-thing finally weakens, it disappears.

name: Deep Sea Carapace
description: Pressure-forged over an age in the dark; the longer the fight, the more of the deep's weight it turns against your foe.

name: Pressure Vessel
description: Built to hold against a crushing deep — it softens the one enormous blow and breathes life back on a slow count.

name: Abyssal Stalkers
description: They take you past the great blind hunters unseen — and lend the first strike, when it comes, a killing edge.

name: Abyssal Treaders
description: Ballasted for the deep — slows and snares and stuns wash over them and recede twice as fast.

name: Virulent Hourglass
description: The sand falls quickly; what it leaves behind grows harder to escape.
